artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: 16 substrate cards, qualification artifacts. No deploy surface: the TO objective is QUALIFY ONLY and nothing is served or promoted.
Five deterministic emitters. Cards are BUILT, never hand-typed; the floor rule and joinable_ref id cleanliness are asserted at build.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: 9 cards exist and all VALIDATE against v2. Every row carries basis + evidence + owner.
acceptance.output_evidence: 16 of 16 cards VALID, 0 errors. NOTE THE COUNT: the criterion says 9 because it was written before the subject set moved 9 -> 15 -> 16; the frozen set at a30be0d6ca gives this lane 16 and all 16 are carded and valid. basis/evidence/owner are schema-REQUIRED on every row, so their presence is structural. Run WITH live negative controls: an out-of-enum key_is_stable, a deleted required coverage.denominator, prose inside a joinable_ref id, and a SOUND verdict over an absent-basis row -- ALL FOUR REJECTED in the same run the real cards passed, so the green is not a dead validator. Two genuine INVALID states were hit and fixed en route: joinable_ref items typed as bare strings, and determinism 'hybrid' without the required inference_detail triple.
acceptance.denominator: 16 of 16 cards; 7 rows each = 112 rows, every one carrying basis+evidence+owner

acceptance.invocation: count cards whose process.cadence.live_matches_declared is populated
acceptance.output_evidence: 16 of 16 cards carry a worked cadence row. The values are not uniform and that is the point: 'no' where declared and live disagree (.comp-graph/graph.json at 20.0d against a 5-min TTL; the S3 kuzu at 20d against a DAILY contract; keep-dormant with 1 of 7 entries past its own decay date), 'yes' where they match (the local kuzu, both warehouse tables), 'not_applicable' where no rhythm is declared at all (hand-authored registries, an on-demand CLI), and 'unmeasured' where I did not establish it. keep-dormant's cadence was EXERCISED against the registry's OWN decay rule rather than read.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: persistence worked; persisted: false is legitimate only if MEASURED.
acceptance.invocation: count persisted booleans; inspect every persisted:false row's basis and evidence
acceptance.output_evidence: 16 of 16 persistence rows carry a boolean. EXACTLY ONE card asserts persisted:false -- comp-heat -- and it is MEASURED, not assumed: I ran `score` and `freshness` and observed that both compute and print with no artifact appearing, so the row's evidence states 'the output is stdout only'. Every other subject is persisted:true with a measured byte size.
acceptance.denominator: 16 of 16 rows; 1 persisted:false, of which measured: 1

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: location.home exact, or null with evidence of where you looked and the search denominator.
acceptance.output_evidence: 16 of 16 cards carry an EXACT home; ZERO are null, so the null-with-search-evidence branch is unexercised and not claimed. Homes are exact paths, S3 URIs or an executable path. One home was recovered only after a near-miss worth recording: s3://opal-estate-report/kuzu_nessie_db sits past comp-keys' 40-row default truncation and I had drafted the sentence calling it ABSENT before head-object corrected it.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: coverage.denominator NON-NULL, 'N of M'; if genuinely uncountable, denominator_absent_reason populated.
acceptance.invocation: count non-null coverage.denominator; for nulls, require denominator_absent_reason
acceptance.output_evidence: 12 of 16 cards carry a NON-NULL denominator. The remaining 4 are genuinely uncountable and EVERY ONE populates denominator_absent_reason, which is the rejectable branch v2 added -- keep-dormant (an opt-in registry whose true denominator is every dormant-looking resource in the estate), SYSTEM_DEFINITIONS (67 terms of an unenumerable vocabulary), both nerves halves (an unbounded edge universe), and the S3 kuzu (never opened, so a row count would be a guess dressed as a measurement). ⛔ THE RICHEST DENOMINATOR IS c2_instances.json's OWN coverage triple, which I read rather than computed: BACKEND 81.2% of side, FRONTEND 13.0%, and KNOWLEDGE 0.0% of 5,851 on-side nodes with in_detector_scope 0 -- a STRUCTURAL zero, not an incidental one.
acceptance.denominator: 12 of 16 non-null; 4 null, 4 of those with denominator_absent_reason

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: key: identity_space, key_is_stable, crosses_spaces; declared_mapping: null only after a hunt.
acceptance.invocation: count key rows carrying all three required fields; count crossings and null mappings
acceptance.output_evidence: 16 of 16 key rows carry all three. 11 of 16 subjects CROSS id spaces and 7 of those carry declared_mapping NULL -- each after a stated hunt, not by default. ⛔ THE MEASUREMENT ANDREW NAMED HIMSELF: only 1,730 of 27,035 canonical node_ids (6.4%) are ARN-shaped, across 5 layers that sum exactly, while .comp-graph/graph.json -- stage one of the C3 chain -- keys on 'gold:MODULE.function' symbols. TWO IDENTITY SPACES, NO DECLARED MAPPING, so a join between the C3 chain's stage-1 store and the projection it must reach cannot be performed on the key. The one subject that DOES declare its mapping in-file is firm_registry, and it is NULL on 2 of 5 firms.
acceptance.denominator: 16 of 16 key rows complete; 11 crossing; 7 crossing with declared_mapping null

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: failure_mode EXERCISED, never read off a docstring.
acceptance.invocation: count failure_mode rows at basis 'measured' (i.e. exercised); inspect the rest
acceptance.output_evidence: 13 of 16 failure-mode rows are EXERCISED at basis measured, each with arms reachable from different truths. The 3 that are not are recorded as unexercised rather than asserted: the harness (running CVO's composer is not my act -- read-only tree) and nerves-edges.json (I refused to borrow its sibling's exercise evidence on a shared name prefix). ⛔ FINDINGS ONLY EXERCISE COULD PRODUCE: comp-heat `score` is a PURE FUNCTION of --age-days -- four ids at fixed age including the literal '!!!not even a path!!!' all returned 0.5000/WARM while varying the flag moved it, so the id is echoed and never resolved. kuzu is loud at three depths (bad label -> Binder exception, bad property -> Binder exception, genuine value miss -> a clean 0). keep-dormant returns a bare False that the guard reads as a DEBT-eligible VERDICT, indistinguishable from a typo. 7 of 16 cards report distinguishable_from_true_negative = no. ⚠ ONE TEST WAS DISCARDED AS INVALID before it reached a row: my first comp-heat probe had both arms failing on a missing required flag, so they collapsed onto one truth and the identical output proved nothing.
acceptance.denominator: 13 of 16 exercised; 3 recorded unexercised with the reason stated

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: declared_opinions POPULATED on every card -- an enumerated array, or null WITH the reason in evidence. Omitting the key passes the schema and FAILS this TO.
acceptance.invocation: assert the key is present on all 16; for nulls, require the reason in methodology.evidence
acceptance.output_evidence: KEY PRESENT ON 16 of 16 -- the criterion this TO warns the schema cannot enforce. 12 cards carry an ENUMERATED array and 4 carry null, and ALL 4 nulls state the reason IN evidence. The reasons are structural, not shrugs: a DIRECTORY has no single producer whose opinions could be enumerated; a store whose GENERATOR IS UNRESOLVED has no known decider, so listing opinions read off the output would be mistaking the artifact for the intent; and an object I never opened can only yield the CONFIG's account of a producer. ⛔ THIS AUDIT CAUGHT A REAL FAILURE OF MINE: my first pass put one reason in `methodology.how` rather than `evidence`, which reads identically to a human and FAILS the criterion as written. Found by checking the field the criterion names instead of the field I had written.
acceptance.denominator: 16 of 16 cards carry the key; 12 enumerated, 4 null, 4 of 4 nulls carrying a reason in evidence

mutant.description: Four defects planted into in-memory copies of validated cards and re-validated: an out-of-enum trust.key.key_is_stable; a deleted required trust.coverage.denominator; prose (' -- ') inside a joinable_ref id; and verdict.standing SOUND over a row at basis 'absent'. The last two target v2-specific constraints rather than generic schema shape.
mutant.expected: All four REJECTED while the unmodified cards validate in the same run.
mutant.observed: All four REJECTED. Unmodified cards: 16 of 16 VALID, same validator object, same run. Both arms reachable from different truths.

determinism.method: All 16 cards are EMITTED by five deterministic builders from in-script measured literals -- no clock call, no randomness, no filesystem scan at build time. Re-running rebuilds byte-identical output. The builders additionally ASSERT two invariants the schema cannot fully express: the FULL basis floor (scalar == MIN over basis_by_field, where the schema enforces only the 'measured' case) and joinable_ref id cleanliness.
determinism.observed: Rebuilt repeatedly across the session after each correction; 16 of 16 VALID on every run. The floor assertion is a LIVE arm: my first cut claimed basis 'measured' over an INFERRED projection_of and the builder now demotes it automatically rather than trusting me to hold the rule.
